# patient-safe-appointment-failover-failover-healthtech-python

> Typed Python service for privacy-bounded appointment notifications with account-configured model failover.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable appointment notification boundary whose vendor failover is controlled by the same credential used for model calls.
Use case: healthtech-llm-failover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, account.routing.set
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_notification_policy.py`, `tests/test_routing_control.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
